newsitem.title: USA: CBOT Sept volume rises 5.9 percent year-on-year.
newsitem.headline: CBOT Sept volume rises 5.9 percent year-on-year.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade (CBOT) said its futures and options volume totalled 17,401,625 contracts in September, up 1.5 percent from 17,137,050 contracts in September 1995.
CBOT added that volume in the first nine months of 1996 had risen 5.9 percent to 170,487,642 contracts from 161,026,010 contracts in the same period a year earlier.
